description: DANGEROUS: a wrong value can make the controller unreachable (then only USB serial or the service access point helps). Changes: host, wifi_mode 0 off / 1 STA / 2 AP, sta {ssid, password, dhcp}, ap {ssid, password, channel 1..13}, lan {enabled, dhcp, static_primary}. apply=true saves AND applies now (no restart; the connection may drop), apply=false only saves for the next boot. Needs MYIO_WRITE=admin.
name: myio_network_set
title: Change network settings
